name: sandip-fas-app
description: Sandip University FAS Management System - Android App

scripts.copy-web: powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path index.html,coordinator-dashboard.html,coordinator-dashboard_temp.html,hod-dashboard.html,student-dashboard.html,privacy-policy.html,terms-of-policy.html -Destination www\ -Force; Copy-Item -Path css -Destination www\css -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path js -Destination www\js -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item -Path public -Destination www\public -Recurse -Force"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android
